criteria.name: Source extraction and wettest removal
criteria.description: Extracts the five event-window precipitation estimates, identifies GPM IMERG mean as the wettest value, and removes only that value for the stress test.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct wettest-source identification with one missing or mislabeled precipitation value.

criteria.name: Retained-source arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes retained mean, minimum, spread, retained-source count, and count at or above 45 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a correct retained mean with one count, minimum, or spread error.

criteria.name: Threshold ledger formula
criteria.description: Applies the 2+1+1+1+1 point formula exactly and reports the final score as 6 of 6.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a correct score with an incomplete component ledger, or for one component error that still shows the formula.

criteria.name: Report-chain extraction
criteria.description: Uses the USGS report text to connect the storm date, deep-seated landslide wording, 13 destroyed houses, and 10 fatalities.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the report text but missing either the impact numbers or the deep-seated wording.

criteria.name: Sentinel scene-pair term
criteria.description: Reads both Sentinel summaries and assigns the image-neutral point because neither has sufficient pre/post scene pairs.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for recognizing one Sentinel summary or the no-scene-pair status without the formula point.

criteria.name: Final JSON and classification
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested fields, units in field names, and the rainfall infiltration deep-seated slope-failure classification.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly correct values with minor JSON or label problems.

criteria.name: Data-bounded reasoning
criteria.description: Keeps the conclusion tied to the computed ledger and report text without inventing geotechnical parameter values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly bounded explanation with one minor overreach.

key_values.formula: score = retained_ge_45 + mean_ge_55 + spread_le_25 + report_chain + image_neutral
